gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the only 2 kWh-and-up kits under $1,500 that ship now are ALLPOWERS kits: R3500 + SP037 400 W (3,168 Wh) at $1,318.24 and R2500 V2 + SP037 400 W (1,920 Wh) at $913.49. Both of ChatGPT's 2 kWh picks are on pre-order today: the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kits dispatch Nov 26, and Jackery says the 200 W panel in its Solar Generator 2000 v2 ships by Nov 28.
standout_why: StormWatts (cited, prices read 2026-11-08) has 24 kits from Jackery, EcoFlow, Anker and BLUETTI. It lists no ALLPOWERS kit, gives no AC watts, and leaves shipping blank on most rows. PowerSized (best/solar-generator, read 2026-11-17) has 3 picks, all with smaller batteries or over $1,500, and gives no ALLPOWERS price. Popular Mechanics (cited) dates from 2020, so it has no current prices. ChatGPT's answers show neither shipping state nor price per Wh. Its Jackery price, $1,239 'with 400 W', contradicts StormWatts' $1,649 for the 2×200 W kit on Nov 8.
decides: The page rule is that the pick must ship now. That pick becomes ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W: 3,168 Wh and 3,200 W for $1,318.24 through our link, $0.42 per Wh. It has the largest battery and the lowest $/Wh of any kit under $1,500. ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 is the cheaper option at 2 kWh and also ships now. ChatGPT's BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W ($1,424.05 through our link) becomes the option for a shopper who can wait until Nov 26 and wants 2,600 W AC from a 2 kWh battery. EcoFlow's 2 kWh kits and Jackery's Solar Generator 2000 v2 only get a 'from' price, because the stores blocked reading the exact panel variants.
